relations.reading: The AICM programme explicitly describes an adapted JUBAP route; the human-transformation article explains the perspective mechanism without establishing that every technique was used there.

relations.title: Revisión del marco
relations.reading: The four-series programme can supply distinct diagnostic questions for reading JUBAP in the field without treating their convergence as four independent validations of the framework.

relations.title: Tres costes de producir claridad
relations.reading: Focus ON can distinguish an observable operating obstacle from a still-unmade declaration of ownership, scope or priority that the diagnosis cannot simply discover.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: JUBAP's expansion-and-filtering sequence offers a practical comparison for moving from architectural optionality to a focusable engineering mission.

relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
relations.reading: JUBAP's propagation logic can be made operational through evidence that the receiving organization can repeat the practice and handle new exceptions after the team leaves.

relations.title: Decisión de arquitectura
relations.reading: The thin integration layers described here can be read through JUBAP as focused interventions that change a leverage point while retaining useful operating capability.

relations.title: Compensación de externalidades de red
relations.reading: The network example suggests a JUBAP leverage point in the funding and transfer rule itself: make the contributing node sustainable so the wider service can work.

relations.title: Compresión narrativa de capacidad
relations.reading: The JUBAP sequence is more useful when each stage retains the capabilities and operating conditions required for it to work, rather than becoming a ritualized checklist.

relations.title: Liberación y análisis causal
relations.reading: The early JUMP UP account adds historical detail to the action filter behind today’s JUBAP sequence of perspective, precision and propagation.

relations.title: Liberación y análisis causal
relations.reading: For a historical explanation of the action filter, the early JUMP UP article shows why a precise intervention depends on preparation and practical entry conditions.
